faq_heading: Homes near Pinewood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Pinewood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Pinewood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Pinewood Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Pinewood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Boundary Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km north) and Seaquam Secondary (1.3 km north).

Pinewood Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11777 Pinewood Dr. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Pinewood Elementary in the listing.
How the Pinewood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Pinewood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Pinewood Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Pinewood Elementary in a straight line (14 elementary, 2 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Boundary Park Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Chalmers Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Seaquam Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Boundary Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km north), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Sunshine Hills Elementary (1.5 km north-west), J T Brown Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Boundary Park Elementary, 1.1 km east of Pinewood Elementary.
